card.name: Inside boxed warning headings and cross-references
card.fires_on: Words inside capitalized boxed-warning titles (F-ET-AL, H-EP-ATITIS, SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND) and the start of cross-referenced section names after [see. Also 'or' in dose range or food phrases.

modes.label: Boxed warning titles
modes.description: Split pieces or linking words inside all-caps warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: F<<ET>>AL TOXICITY See full prescribing

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The first piece of a section name such as Adverse Reactions or Dosage after [see.

modes.label: Linking 'or' in labels
